title: finding(core): an array-of-strings `sort` loses the authored ordering with ZERO diagnostics, while the retired scalar spelling of the same idea is refused out loud
body:
An **array-of-strings** `sort` loses an authored row ordering with **no diagnostic at all**, while the retired **scalar** string spelling of the same idea is refused **out loud**. Measured in one run, three legs, on objectui `origin/main` `d6a84446f`:

```
scalar-string CONTROL     $orderby=undefined   retired-diagnostics=1   ("…legacy string `sort` clause is retired…")
array-of-strings          $orderby=undefined   retired-diagnostics=0   ⛔
declared-array CONTROL    $orderby="name desc" retired-diagnostics=0
```

⇒ ⭐ the two controls are what make the middle row a reading: the same probe emits a diagnostic for one retired spelling and a working `$orderby` for the declared one, and is silent only here.

## The contract this violates — the file argues against its own behaviour

`packages/core/src/utils/sort-query.ts` names **an array of strings** as an unusable input in the very docblock that justifies the loud refusal, seat-verified at source on `origin/main` `272a53066`, `:66`:

> … those into a row order that **quietly stopped applying** — the exact failure this …

⭐ Control from the same command: `retired` occurs on **7** lines of that file, so the module is squarely about retired spellings and the silence on this one is not an oversight of subject.

## Class (a) — a user-visible loss with a reproducible probe

An author writes `sort: ['name asc']` (or any array of strings), the grid renders **unordered**, and nothing in the console says why. The neighbouring spelling `sort: 'name asc'` gets a sentence telling the author exactly what to write instead.

## ⚠️ Scope boundary, so the fix is not mis-sized

⛔ This is ⛔ **not** objectui#9607's empty-array observation, which the seat closed as a **measured no-op** (an empty `sort` reaches a guard — `data-objectstack/src/index.ts:4654` `if (request.sort && request.sort.length > 0)` — that makes it indistinguishable from an absent key at the wire, ablation-proven on both ends). ⭐ This card is **the same input one layer up**, on the **fetch** path rather than the export path, and here the loss is real.

⚠️ **NOT MEASURED**: how many authored documents in the wild carry the array-of-strings spelling; the fix's shape (emit the existing retired-spelling diagnostic for this arm, or accept and normalise the spelling) is the claiming seat's measurement, ⛔ not this filing's.

## Dedupe words

`array of strings sort silently dropped` · `retired sort spelling no diagnostic` · `normalizeSortEntries skips entry no field silent` · `refused out loud not dropped in silence` · `sort-query array arm diagnostic`
